application_title.description: Application name displayed on OAuth consent screen.
application_title.rationale: Cosmetic title shown on the OAuth consent screen. It is descriptive metadata; a platform policy cannot meaningfully constrain free-text titles and doing so improves no security control.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Non-secret project identifier scoping the brand resource. We don't constrain project references, and a generic policy cannot know the correct project.

support_email.description:
Support email displayed on the OAuth consent screen. Can be either a
user or group email. When a user email is specified, the caller must
be the user with the associated email address. When a group email is
specified, the caller can be either a user or a service account which
is an owner of the specified group in Cloud Identity.
support_email.rationale: Support contact email shown on the OAuth consent screen. It is contact metadata, and enforcing a specific (corporate) address would require hardcoding a team-specific email, which is overreaching.
